title: Non-Gaussian Uncertainty Estimation via Semi-nonparametric Density
abstract: arXiv:2604.09375v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate and efficient representation of non-Gaussian state distributions is critical for estimation, control, and decision-making, especially when the system is highly nonlinear. This paper develops a mathematical framework for estimating non-Gaussian uncertainty via semi-nonparametric (SNP), or Gallant-Nychka, densities. SNP densities use squared probabilists' Hermite polynomials to guarantee nonnegative probability densities while representing non-Gaussian behavior. For uncertainty propagation, once fitted to propagated state samples, SNP densities enable direct analytical density and probability evaluations without needing to tune additional hyperparameters besides the polynomial order. To enable their application to nonlinear dynamical systems, we derive analytic marginal and cumulative distribution functions and develop a lossless convex formulation of the coefficient estimation problem along a given sign branch. translated_title: 基于半非参数密度的非高斯不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 准确且高效地表示非高斯状态分布对于估计、控制和决策至关重要，尤其是当系统具有高度非线性时。本文开发了一个通过半非参数（SNP）密度（即Gallant-Nychka密度）估计非高斯不确定性的数学框架。SNP密度使用平方概率Hermite多项式来保证概率密度函数的非负性，同时能够刻画非高斯行为。在不确定性传播方面，一旦对传播后的状态样本完成拟合，SNP密度便可直接进行解析的密度和概率评估，且除多项式阶数外无需调节其他超参数。为了将其应用于非线性动力学系统，我们推导了解析的边际分布函数和累积分布函数，并在给定符号分支上提出了系数估计问题的无损凸公式化方法。
tldr: 本文提出了基于半非参数（SNP）密度的非高斯不确定性估计框架，利用平方Hermite多项式保证密度非负性，推导了解析的边际分布与累积分布函数并给出无损凸的系数估计方法，除多项式阶数外无需额外超参数即可直接应用于非线性动力学系统的不确定性传播。
